intro: Lamentations is five poems of grief, written after Babylon destroyed Jerusalem.
Chapters one and two mourn the ruined city. Chapter three, at the very centre, finds hope: his compassions fail not; they are new every morning.
Chapters four and five end in prayer.
Tradition holds that Jeremiah wrote it.
Listen for how the Bible makes room for grief, and how faith holds on inside it.

card.parts: Ch. 1–2: a city in ruins | Ch. 3: hope at the centre | Ch. 4–5: prayer
